definition.criterion: 新方案缺少適用情境、claims 或 rationale 時，方案完整性及確認入口均列出缺項；草稿保存成功；完整計畫不被誤報驗收通過。
definition.validation method: Host completeness and materialization integration tests

AC-001.rationale: Completeness and confirmation decisions are host CLI contracts.

definition.criterion: 重現 SPEC-0068 revision 2 pending → 補 AC-003 對照 → reconcile → confirmed → admission，沿用同一來源事件；準備期間產品寫入仍拒絕。

AC-002.rationale: Replay the firmware incident as isolated host state fixtures; no device claim.

definition.criterion: 保持 ID 不變而修改需求、驗收內容、门檻、既有對照；或一般 reopen、撤銷、跨身份、損壞歷史、未知差異時，均拒絕沿用授權且產品檔案不變。

AC-003.rationale: Negative authorization boundaries are host state-machine behavior.

definition.criterion: 並行變更、中斷與同一請求重放不覆寫變更、不重複套用、不增加權限；恢復只能使用驗證完整的轉換。
definition.validation method: Host concurrency and fault-injection integration tests

AC-004.rationale: Host locking, interrupted saves and idempotency require deterministic fault injection.

definition.criterion: 舊授權案例在歷史與雜湊可重建時通過；缺證據時指出具體缺項且保存原紀錄。

AC-005.rationale: Legacy recovery verifies document hashes and journal continuity on the host.

definition.criterion: 原有授權、撤銷與管理入口回歸通過；技能、流程及 docs 對允許的例外描述一致；組裝外掛與 distribution validation 通過。
definition.validation method: Existing regression suite, documentation review and distribution validation

AC-006.rationale: Regression and assembled distribution checks do not claim desktop hook firing or physical validation.
